title: Concept: R session that points at a cleartext repository
description: .Rprofile declares an `options(repos=)` value over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads an `options(repos=)` value over cleartext.
